faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers to common questions about dental treatments, appointments, insurance, and aftercare.
faq.contactPrompt: Have a specific question not covered here? Speak directly with our friendly reception team.

items.question: How often should I visit the dentist for a check-up and clean?
items.answer: We recommend visiting every 6 months for a routine examination and professional hygiene cleaning. Regular check-ups help catch minor issues before they become complex and keep your teeth healthy.

items.question: Do you offer cosmetic dental treatments and smile makeovers?
items.answer: Yes, we provide a full range of aesthetic dental treatments including custom porcelain veneers, composite bonding, professional laser teeth whitening, and discreet clear aligners.

items.question: Is in-clinic teeth whitening safe for sensitive teeth?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our clinic uses advanced, enamel-safe whitening systems formulated with desensitising agents to protect your enamel and minimise sensitivity while delivering fast results.

items.question: Do you provide same-day emergency dental appointments?
items.answer: Yes, we reserve daily slots specifically for dental emergencies, such as acute toothaches, chipped or knocked-out teeth, and lost crowns. Call our direct helpline for immediate assistance.

items.question: What payment methods and dental financing do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major debit and credit cards, Apple Pay, private dental insurance, and flexible 0% interest monthly payment plans to spread the cost of larger treatments.

items.question: What happens during my initial consultation?
items.answer: Your first visit includes a comprehensive oral exam, digital intraoral 3D scan, low-radiation digital x-rays, periodontal gum screening, and a personalised discussion of treatment options.
